scheme_name: E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughter’s of Poor Widows: Scheme-II
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow and the mother of a girl child
Assistance is granted for the marriage of only one daughter per mother

Bride must be either a degree holder from regular colleges, distance education or a government‑recognized open university, or a diploma holder from an institution recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
Benefit may be given to the bride in case of the death of the widowed mother
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 along with a 22‑carat (8 gm) gold sovereign for the bride’s Thirumangalyam.
